About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 Join Anthropic's Commercial Legal team as a Technical AI implementation specialist, where you'll be responsible for leveraging Claude and other technologies to scale and increase efficiency of legal operations. You'll drive AI adoption across team workflows, optimize internal tooling, and lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance productivity. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of legal operations through technology while working with Claude and other business critical systems.
 Key responsibilities 
 Implement AI-powered solutions to streamline contract review and redlining processes
 Manage integrations between existing legal systems and AI tools
 Develop automated self-service solutions for high-volume, low-touch contracting processes, including FAQ chatbots and guided workflows
 Create AI-based tools for handling commercial contract diligence requests
 Optimize contract management platforms with AI capabilities
 Create and manage comprehensive program plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation, to guide project execution
 Build and maintain metrics dashboards to track efficiency improvements
 Establish practical governance processes for AI use in legal operations
 Coordinate with Engineering and Product teams on solution development
 Identify and mitigate potential risks and issues that could affect program success, ensuring proactive problem-solving
 Minimum qualifications 
 Experience evaluating and implementing legal technology platforms such as contract management systems, workflow management systems, or document management tools
 Show genuine curiosity about AI/ML applications and hands-on experience with LLM tools (especially Claude!)
 Possess excellent problem-solving skills and can translate legal business needs into scalable technical solutions
 Excel at cross-functional collaboration and can communicate effectively with both technical and legal stakeholders
 Self-directed and can manage multiple technical projects simultaneously
 Preferred qualifications 
 At least 5 years of relevant experience in legal operations, legal technology, or technical roles supporting legal teams
 Technical aptitude with system integration knowledge
 Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science 
 Excellent verbal and written communication, analytical, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
 Proven project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver quality results
 Collaborative team player mindset with genuine interest in technology development and AI, thriving in fast-paced environments
 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $170,000 — $220,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 
 Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
 Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
 As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.
 We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
 Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in developing high-quality, validated markers that extract insights from dense temporal stacks of satellite imagery across agriculture, land management, and climate. The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers to deploy models at scale, while expanding beyond compliance into land-cover change detection using embeddings and AI-first workflows.
 Ideal candidates are adaptable, curious about AI agents, and eager to iterate directly based on customer feedback. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to work with multi-sensor Earth observation data to solve complex environmental and agricultural challenges.
 This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Graz, Ljubljana or Haarlem office 3 days per week.
 Impact You’ll Own: 
 Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run.
 Take a research topic from exploration through to production.
 Own marker results for production AMS deliveries across several EU countries — run them, review them, and confirm quality before they reach the client.
 Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP.
 Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it.
 Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team.
 Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them.
 Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable.
 Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients.
 What You Bring: 
 4+ years of relevant work experience.
 Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field.
 Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques.
 Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code.
 Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools.
 Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase.
 Working knowledge of the geospatial domain.
 Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables.
 Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains.
 Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.
 What Makes You Stand Out: 
 Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery.
 Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series.
 Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1).
 Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes.
 Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing.

description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the Role
 Anthropic is building the Forward Deployed Engineering team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Technical Deployment Leads (TDLs) and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. Our delivery model pairs two roles: FDEs own the technical artifact, and TDLs own the engagement end to end, from statement of work (SOW) through production deployment.
 As a Manager of Technical Deployment in EMEA, you lead a team of TDLs embedded with strategic customers. You own engagement portfolio health across your team, set the bar for delivery quality, and define where we play: which customers and which use cases are ready for production AI today. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation across the region. This role is based in London.
 This is a player-coach role. You need to be credible in architecture conversations with a customer's engineering leads and equally comfortable in front of executive sponsors. You will also lead the most complex engagements yourself when the stakes call for it. Most of your impact will come through the people you hire and the standard you hold them to. You won't write production code, but you will pressure-test the technical decisions your TDL team makes with FDEs.
 Responsibilities
 Hire, develop, and retain a team of TDLs embedded in engagements across EMEA. Set a high bar for delivery judgment, technical fluency, and customer presence, and run the interview loop that holds that bar.
 Manage each TDL directly: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, direct feedback, and a growth plan. Build a bench that runs engagements well without you in the room.
 Define the delivery strategy for your portfolio: which kinds of companies we engage, which use cases we prioritize, and how that differs by market and industry. Hold each TDL accountable for a clear account strategy: what we want to achieve with the customer and the exit gates that tell us we got there.
 Own portfolio health across your team. Track which engagements are on track, at risk, or closing out, and intervene early when delivery drifts. Run engagement quality reviews with your team.
 Own customer outcomes across the portfolio. Hold the executive relationship with customer sponsors, run steering committees, and represent Anthropic with senior business, risk, legal, and engineering leaders.
 Make the staffing call for each engagement. Work with FDE managers to match TDLs and engineers to each customer, and adjust as scope changes.
 Lead the most complex engagements yourself. Take the TDL seat when engagement size, regulatory exposure, or organizational complexity calls for it, from SOW through production deployment.
 Set the bar for delivery excellence: SOW quality, MVP scoping, and value measurement. Ensure every engagement has a defensible impact story.
 Build regulatory requirements into how the team scopes and delivers, working with Legal, Security, and customer risk functions, so compliance shapes the plan from the start rather than blocking it late.
 Codify reusable solution patterns, evaluation frameworks, and technical playbooks across the team. Turn what works in the field into delivery infrastructure that lets the practice scale, and adapt global playbooks to EMEA markets.
 Partner with Sales to qualify engagements, shape scope, and inform SOWs. Partner with Marketing and Sales on EMEA go-to-market materials, reference cases, and positioning.
 Run the team's operating rhythm: engagement reviews, knowledge-sharing, and escalation support, and feed the wider post-sales cadence and dashboards. Set team goals tied to customer outcomes.
 Bring the field back to Anthropic. Surface delivery lessons and emerging use cases from EMEA to Product and Research, and represent the region in leadership discussions.
 Consistently uphold Anthropic's values as you lead your team. TDLs should be strong representatives of Anthropic's culture as they work within customer environments.
 Travel to customer sites across EMEA (25–50% expected), with occasional travel to the US.
 You May Be a Good Fit If You
 Have 8+ years leading enterprise AI/ML delivery, whether you came up as a founder, engineer, data scientist, or researcher and moved into deployments, with at least 3 years directly managing people who owned delivery outcomes.
 Have a track record of building and leading technical delivery teams in enterprise environments across more than one EMEA market, ideally including embedded or forward-deployed teams working at client sites.
 Have delivered AI/ML or LLM-based agentic solutions into production. You understand solution patterns, integration approaches, and what breaks in real environments.
 Bring depth in at least one industry (e.g., financial services, healthcare and life sciences). You understand how security, compliance, and regulatory review shape what ships, and you can speak credibly with a CIO, a chief risk officer, and a head of engineering.
 Know the EMEA enterprise landscape: how buying and procurement differ across markets, and how regulatory requirements affect what customers can deploy.
 Can navigate architecture discussions with engineering stakeholders, evaluate technical trade-offs, and judge whether a proposed agent design is realistic.
 Have experience with value-based scoping, including TCO/ROI quantification and post-deployment impact measurement.
 Thrive in ambiguity and bring structure where none exists. You have built a team, practice, or function from an early stage.
 Have executive presence: polished, credible, and concise with senior leaders in high-stakes settings, and just as effective in a hands-on engagement review with your team.
 Have strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences. Working proficiency in a second European language such as German or French is a plus.
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 £190,000 — £230,000 GBP 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About Uncovr
 Uncovr is building AI-powered infrastructure for the future of surgery.
 We work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, surgical video, clinical workflows, and healthcare technology. Our mission is to help surgical teams better understand, document, and improve surgical procedures by turning complex clinical data into structured, useful, and trustworthy insights.
 We are a fast-moving startup working on technically ambitious problems with real-world clinical impact. As we expand our platform, we are looking for a Cloud Architect to help design, build, and manage the cloud infrastructure that supports our product, data pipelines, AI systems, and engineering workflows.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Senior Cloud Architect to own the design, setup, and reliability of Uncovr’s cloud infrastructure.
 In this role, you will design and manage the cloud systems needed for hosting, data transfer, storage, monitoring, security, scalability, and deployment. You will establish strong DevOps practices across the engineering team, including CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, deployment workflows, logging, alerting, monitoring systems, and observability tools for continuous deployment.

 Generate:Biomedicines is seeking an experienced and strategic drug developer and people leader to guide our late-stage Immunology and Inflammation (I&I) programs. Reporting directly to the Chief Medical Officer I&I, this senior business leader will shape integrated development strategies and lead cross-functional teams from late-stage clinical development through regulatory submission and approval. 
 The successful VP, Head of I&I Development candidate will recruit, build, and develop a high-performing team of physicians and scientists, creating clear accountability while enabling strong collaboration across Clinical Operations, Safety, Regulatory, Biometrics, Translational Sciences, and other key functions. They will be accountable for the design and delivery of rigorous late-phase development programs, ensuring scientific and clinical excellence, robust safety oversight, data integrity, and alignment with the company’s broader strategy. 
 The ideal candidate is an MD, MD/PhD, or PhD with significant biopharmaceutical industry experience in immunology and a demonstrated track record of strategic drug development, executional excellence in pivotal trials, and building and leading high-performing teams. 
 Here's how you will contribute: 
 Leads a high performing Product Strategy Team (PST) comprised of cross-functional leaders accountable for setting the strategy for the late stage I&I programs

 Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of physicians and clinical scientists. 
 Hold teams to high standards for technical and collaborative performance

 Promote enterprise thinking and cross-functional alignment with strategic goals
 Communicate with clarity, courage, and empathy across all levels of the organization
 Foster resilience, adaptability, and informed risk-taking in pursuit of innovation
 The Ideal Candidate will have: 
 MD, MD/PhD, or PhD is required. Board certification in Pulmonology, Allergy and Immunology, or Rheumatology is preferred but not required.
 10+ years of drug development experience in the biopharma industry
 4+ years direct people management experience in industry
 Deep expertise in global late-stage (Phase III) clinical trials
 Prior ex perience leading a cross-functional clinical development team through pivotal development and successful BLA/NDA submission 
 Demonstrated success in leading pivotal global studies and regulatory interactions
 Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills

 Respiratory experience in clinical practice, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development or as Proje ct Leader 
 Location: Somerville, MA / Andover, MA; remote (U.S.) optional with travel to HQ based on business needs.
 Why Join Us 
 This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of immunology and inflammation medicine at a company pioneering Generative Biology™. You’ll be empowered to lead transformative trials in a collaborative, mission-driven environment, surrounded by relentless problem solvers who are reimagining what’s possible in drug discovery and development. You’ll have the scope, visibility, and autonomy to influence both the success of the portfolio and the capabilities of the organization, working alongside ambitious, collaborative leaders who are reimagining how medicines are discovered and developed for patients with significant unmet needs.
 About Generate:Biomedicines 
 We are a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein-based medicines.
 Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. 
 About SkinVision 
 Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. 
 Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision 
 We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! 
 What you will do 
 Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. 
 Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. 
 Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). 
 Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. 
 Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. 
 Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. 
 Support and mentor team members. 
 Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. 
 Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. 
 Your profile 
 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. 
 Skills 
 Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan. 
 Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. 
 Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring. 
 Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment. 
 Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions. 
 Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets. 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. 
 Experience with mentoring and leading team members. 
 What we offer you 
 A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy 
 A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam 
 An enthusiastic, professional, and international team 
 Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities 
 Unlimited skin checks for you

description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As a Customer Success Manager on Anthropic's Public Sector team, you will be the post-sales trusted advisor helping national security customers realize the value of Claude and turn their investment into mission impact. You'll combine your customer success expertise with technical fluency to drive adoption of Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government (C4G) on classified infrastructure delivered through a cleared cloud provider, while maintaining our high standards for safety, security, and discretion.
 Working closely with our Sales, Applied AI, Product, Engineering, and Policy teams, you'll guide customers from deployment through enablement, model migration, renewal, and expansion. You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers' AI leadership, platform and compute teams, security and accreditation officials, and mission operators—and with the cleared cloud providers and system integrators that deliver alongside us. Your understanding of their mission, how they accredit and govern capabilities on classified fabrics, and how they evidence value to oversight will help them deliver decision advantage.
 Drawing on both your national security expertise and technical knowledge, you'll serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us—helping them navigate constraints that don't exist in commercial or federal civilian deployments: classified-fabric accreditation, fixed compute capacity, compartmentation, limited telemetry, and need-to-know discipline. Much of this work happens onsite, in the customer's spaces, on their systems. 
 Your role focuses on driving consumption and adoption of Claude across mission workloads, standing up enablement and change management suited to a cleared, mission-driven workforce, identifying and hardening the workloads that matter most to the mission, and demonstrating value in unclassified terms that can leave the building and support renewal and expansion. 
 The insights you gather will directly inform our research priorities, product roadmap, and national security strategy—making you a key voice in shaping how Anthropic builds and delivers AI systems for the most demanding missions. 
 Key responsibilities: 
 Partner with the account executive and Applied AI architect to deeply understand the customer's mission requirements and translate them into an account and success plan, ensuring alignment between mission objectives, the customer's investment, and technical implementation
 Serve as the primary post-sales advisor to the customer throughout their Claude adoption journey, from deployment through enablement, model migration, renewal, and expansion. You will need to build trusted relationships across the customer's senior stakeholders—AI leadership, platform and compute teams, security and accreditation officials, contracting, and mission operators—and coordinate internally across multiple teams and with cleared cloud providers to drive customer success
 Support customers building with Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government on classified infrastructure—managed configuration, capacity and throughput planning, and workload onboarding—with a working understanding of accreditation requirements (FedRAMP High, IL5/IL6, classified-fabric accreditation)
 Create and deliver compelling enablement and executive content tailored to different audiences. You will need to spread the gamut from hands-on Claude Code enablement for engineering teams (Train the Trainer, managed configuration as the "paved road," Center of Excellence development) up to mission-value conversations with senior agency leadership, in unclassified language that can leave the building
 Help the customer develop evaluation frameworks and measure adoption and value without direct telemetry—provider capacity reports, customer-run dashboards, workload registries, and agreed leading indicators—and guide model migration and release readiness: eval gates built from their workloads, staged cutovers off end-of-support models, and realistic expectations about what lands on their fabric and when
 Drive consumption and adoption: separate under-pacing from burst saturation of a fixed compute pool, smooth and onboard workloads before asking for capacity, discover new mission workloads across compartmented organizations, and document value realized in mission-outcome terms (decisions accelerated, coverage, timeliness, findings produced)
 Own Executive Business Reviews that function as discovery and alignment—leaving executives with sponsor commitments, mutual next steps, and a mission-outcome narrative that supports the renewal decision—and serve as the primary conduit between the customer, cleared cloud providers, and Anthropic
 Identify common adoption and integration patterns and hero workflows that demonstrate mission transformation, and contribute insights back to our Product, Engineering, Research, and Policy teams—while maintaining strict separation of classified and unclassified channels and escalating correctly (e.g., 'Claude cut a high-volume analytic triage queue from days to hours')
 Work onsite frequently at customer facilities for enablement, workshops, and relationship building, on the customer’s systems and within their security and need-to-know rules
 Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, agentic and Claude Code implementation patterns, and national security AI policy
 You may be a good fit if you have: 
 Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship and an active TS/SCI security clearance with a current full-scope polygraph (a TS/SCI with CI polygraph may be considered where crossover is supportable)
 Must have prior experience working with US national security (defense and/or intelligence) agencies —ideally at the level of AI leadership, platform, and compute teams rather than a single program office—and a working knowledge of how national security agencies accredit, budget, govern compute, and measure mission (including the difference between FedRAMP High, IL5/IL6, and classified-fabric accreditation, and the role of cleared cloud providers and system integrators)
 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, or Consultant, with experience navigating complex stakeholder environments; able to work onsite at customer facilities in the National Capital Region 3-4 days per week
 Experience driving success with consumption-based products (tokens, throughput, capacity) as well as seat-based products, including measuring adoption and value when you cannot see usage directly
 Technical fluency with AI/ML concepts, API integration patterns, and agentic tooling such as Claude Code; familiarity with common LLM frameworks, tools, and evaluation approaches, and hands-on experience building something with an LLM API or coding agent, is a strong plus
 Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, from engineering and platform teams to security and accreditation officials to senior national security leadership
 Judgment and discretion: never over-promises on dates, capabilities, or documentation; practices need-to-know as a reflex; keeps composure under political and competitive pressure; strategic mindset to identify mission transformation opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
 Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities—advocating for customer needs across internal (Applied AI, Policy, Research, Security) and external (cleared cloud provider, system integrator, program office) stakeholders
 Passion for thinking creatively about how to use AI in a way that is safe and beneficial for the national security mission, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
 A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic 'roll up your sleeves' mentality—you're a true team player
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $265,000 — $350,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
ABOUT CUSPAI 

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.




THE ROLE

Due to the rapid scaling of our compute requirements, we are seeking a Performance Engineer to serve as the vital bridge between our frontier AI models and our high-performance computing infrastructure.




YOUR IMPACT

In this role you will be building the optimization layers and profiling infrastructure that maximizes the efficiency of our large-scale training and inference workloads, which is critical for accelerating our materials discovery pipeline and ensuring our researchers can iterate at the speed of thought.

 

At CuspAI, compute is our most precious resource. Your main focus initially will be profiling our current training runs to identify bottlenecks in Model FLOP Utilization (MFU). Over time you are likely to get involved in designing custom kernels and low-level optimizations that allow us to train larger, more complex models for chemistry and physics that were previously computationally prohibitive.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Training & Inference Optimization

 - Analyze model architectures to optimize how mathematical operations map onto hardware, specifically focusing on NVIDIA GPU kernels and collective communication layers (NCCL).

 - Implement state-of-the-art efficiency techniques such as quantization, model pruning, and distillation to lower latency for our materials “search engine” APIs.

 - Streamline data pipelines to ensure high-performance accelerators are never “starved” for data during massive training runs.
   
   

Profiling, Observability & Cost Management

 - Use advanced observability tools to trace end-to-end execution of training jobs, pinpointing exact locations of processing clogs or interconnect contention.

 - Build and maintain real-time dashboards tracking vital system metrics, including MFU, memory bandwidth utilization, and cluster uptime.

 - Monitor and justify the utilization of our AI accelerators (e.g. H100 clusters), preventing idle time and memory leaks to ensure every dollar of compute spend translates into scientific progress.

 - Develop scaling laws and internal tools to predict system behavior across compute, memory, and networking as our models grow in parameter count.
   
   

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

 - Work closely with AI Researchers to adapt model architectures for better hardware compatibility without sacrificing scientific accuracy.

 - Partner with the Infrastructure team to influence the design of our future compute clusters based on performance data and profiling results.




MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 - You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that Cusp is building.

 - You have 3+ years of experience in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, or low-level software development, specifically focused on high-performance computing (HPC) or AI workloads.

 - Expert-level knowledge of GPU architecture and experience optimizing CUDA kernels or using libraries like Triton.

 - Deep understanding of distributed training frameworks (e.g. PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, or Megatron-LM) and networking protocols.

 - Proficiency in profiling tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, or Weights & Biases for performance tracking.

 - A "builder" mindset with the ability to work autonomously in an early-stage, fast-paced startup environment.




BONUS POINTS (BUT NOT CRITICAL):

 - Experience working with specialized AI hardware such as TPUs or alternative accelerators.

 - An academic background or personal interest in Materials Science, Chemistry, or Physics.

 - Knowledge of MLOps practices, specifically regarding the deployment of models at scale in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).

 - Contributions to open-source performance optimization or machine learning libraries.
   




ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

As part of your onboarding, you will be expected to spend at least a few weeks in our Cambridge/London office learning about our platform and getting to know us in person.

Additionally, there may be regular travel required to Europe and other regional and global locations for collaboration and project work.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

 - Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

 - Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

 - ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

 - Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

 - Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

 - True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 About Iso 
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
 Your impact 
 As part of the ongoing expansion of our Drug Design and Medical Research (DDMR) function, we are looking to recruit our first Technical Program Manager to our Cambridge, MA office. 
 As a member of the Technical Program Management team you will be responsible for facilitating all aspects of small molecule drug discovery program management for Cambridge programs, providing hands-on support to our AI-first Drug Design programs, ensuring smooth integration with our London office. You will work in alignment with the drug design teams in Cambridge and liaise with key internal stakeholders across finance, legal, alliance management and AI/tech.
 If you are an organised, skilled and ambitious individual looking to take the next step in your career, joining Isomorphic Labs now will lift you out of your comfort zone and provide you with an amazing opportunity for personal growth and development. 
 What you will do 
 As a member of the TPM team you will be responsible for supporting DDMR with program planning, dynamically monitoring timelines, action tracking, risk reporting, driving effective meetings and stakeholder management
 You will manage and monitor program budgets with respect to forecasting and actual spend to support the program team, DDMR and TPM team as well as report out to senior stakeholders
 You will provide help to program teams to effectively liaise with CROs and other external providers/partners, helping with contract reviews and processing
 You will help to build and embed processes and operating systems, ensuring integration and alignment across Isolabs
 Skills and qualifications 
 Essential: 
 At least a BSc in Biology, Chemistry or related discipline
 Proven industry experience in contributing to, managing or leading early stage / discovery small molecule and / or glue and / or peptide drug design programs 
 Understanding of small molecule / glue / peptide drug discovery & development processes in the context of project & program planning, and governance 
 Experience of managing budgets, including planning, forecasting, monitoring, troubleshooting and working to identify efficiencies
 Experience of operational program management processes
 Experience with program risk management
 Experience supporting teams in fast-paced and constantly changing environments 
 Ability to adaptively interact and confidently communicate with diverse key stakeholders
 Patient, organised and detail-oriented
 Nice to have: 
 Advanced degree in Biology, Chemistry or related discipline
 Program management qualification
 Experience of working in an ML drug discovery environment
 Working with Jira and / or confluence or other program management software
Culture and values 
 We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it. 
 Thoughtful
 Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day. 
 Brave
 Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less. 
 Determined
 Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we. 
 Together
 Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere. 
Creating an extraordinary company 
 We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.
 We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.
Hybrid working 
 It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.
 Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy .

description:
ABOUT CUSPAI 

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.




THE ROLE

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.




YOUR IMPACT

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.




APPLICATION AREAS

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

 - Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

 - Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

 - Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

 - Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.




WHAT YOU WILL DO


PROJECT LEADERSHIP AND DELIVERY

 - Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

 - Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

 - Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.


SCIENCE AND CAMPAIGNS

 - Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

 - Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

 - Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.


BRIDGING EXPERIMENTAL AND COMPUTATIONAL TEAMS

 - Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

 - Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

 - Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.


CAPABILITY AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

 - Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

 - Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows.

 - Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team.




MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

 - Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation.

 - A track record in one or more of the application areas above.

 - Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git).

 - Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them.

 - A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science.




BONUS POINTS (BUT NOT CRITICAL)

 - Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors.

 - Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals.

 - Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level.

 - Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible.

 - Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment.

 - Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company.




ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS

These roles can be based in our Singapore office, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work.


The working hours will need some overlap with our teams in Europe, and onboarding includes a few weeks in our Cambridge or London office to learn the platform and meet the team in person.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

 - Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

 - Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

 - ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

 - Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

 - Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

 - True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

As an AI Deployment Strategist, AI4Eng for Physics and Engineering in APAC, you are Mistral's forward-deployed operator on strategic enterprise accounts across automotive, aerospace, semiconductors, industrial equipment, and energy. You own the delivery of AI solutions for physics and engineering challenges end-to-end.


Discovery, Scoping & Solution Design:

 - Run technical discovery sessions to understand business and engineering requirements.

 - Identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases aligned with the customer's strategic R&D and product-development challenges.

 - Translate business goals into a concrete AI roadmap and high-level solution architecture, validating feasibility with Product and Applied AI teams.

 - Build ROI models and business value propositions, and own scoping documents and SOW inputs.


Delivery & Program Management

 - Own end-to-end delivery: discovery → design → build → deploy → adoption.

 - Set up the account operating model: governance, decision forums, and cadence.

 - Drive day-to-day execution: priorities, milestones, unblockers, and risk management.

 - Drive scope control and change management, ensuring the right artifacts are produced (design doc, runbook, eval plan, rollout plan, handover).

 - Bring knowledge of processes and regulations from the industries we serve (aerospace, semiconductor, automotive, industrial equipment, energy).
   

Adoption, Value Realization & Expansion

 - Lead user testing, training, change management, and developer enablement.

 - Track value realization against agreed KPIs and report to executive sponsors.

 - Capture field learnings and feed product gaps and platform needs back to Product, Science, and Engineering.
   


ABOUT YOU

 - Advanced university degree in physics or engineering, or IT.

 - 5+ years of experience as a (technical) project manager in a relevant industry, e.g., automotive, semiconductors, or aerospace.

 - Experience in software development, machine learning, and ideally in numerical simulations for physics and engineering (CAE, CFD, FEM, DEM, etc.).

 - Hands-on coding proficiency (Python at minimum), with the ability to read design docs and hold your own in deep technical conversations with data scientists, ML engineers, and simulation engineers.

 - Strong grasp of where AI creates value in computational science: surrogate models, PDE solvers, FEM/CFD acceleration, inverse problems, and differentiable simulation.

 - Familiarity with deployment patterns (SaaS, VPC, on-prem, hybrid), security and compliance basics, and ideally agile project management methodologies.

 - Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms and to manage C-level stakeholders.
   

We are looking for adaptable team players who excel in a fast-paced environment, are ready to own delivery across APAC accounts, and are prepared to support pre-sales motions to contribute to our shared goals and growth.



INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Talent Acquisition screening call (30 min)

 - 30 min Hiring Manager Interview

 - 45 min Technical Interview (physics, simulation, and AI deep dive)

 - 45 min Business Acumen Interview

 - Panel (Customer Meeting Role-Play & Use Case Scoping Exercise, 1h)

 - 30 min Value Talk

 - Reference check




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
